project_type: Next.js 16 full-stack app with React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, feature-based architecture
build_system: npm with Next.js build, mise for node activation
test_framework: vitest with @testing-library/react, tests in __tests__/ directories per feature
build_command: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run build
test_command: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run test
verification_instructions: 1. Delete .next folder. 2. Run: npx tsc --noEmit. 3. Run: npm run lint. 4. Run: npm run build. 5. Run: npm run test.
setup_instructions: eval "$(mise activate bash)" to activate Node, then npm commands work. Delete .next before tsc checks.
environment_constraints: Must use eval "$(mise activate bash)" before any npm/npx command. .next directory must be deleted before tsc checks due to stale type validator references.
contribution_requirements: No TODOs/placeholders. Feature-based folders. No cross-feature imports (use src/shared/). Run tsc --noEmit && lint && build && test before commit.
key_patterns: CSS vars for theming (--foreground, --card-bg, --accent-primary etc). Inline style={{ color: 'var(--foreground)' }} pattern. lucide-react icons. localStorage for user data. Client components marked 'use client'. Dynamic imports with next/dynamic for heavy components. RelatedActions component at bottom of pages.
directory_structure: src/app/(protected)/ contains 18+ route directories. src/features/ contains 24 feature modules. src/shared/ has config, components/layout, components/ui, and lib. Navigation config in src/shared/config/navigation.ts defines 4 sidebar groups with 15 total items.
